Three sheets covering the [ggsegverse](https://ggsegverse.github.io). Each one
is a two-page PDF for printing and an accessible HTML page for reading, built
from the same source, with every example executed against the real packages.

## The sheets

| Sheet | Covers | |
|-------|--------|---|
| [2D brain plotting with ggseg](ggseg.qmd) | `geom_brain()`, view arrangement, palettes, themes | [PDF](ggseg.pdf) |
| [3D brain plotting with ggseg3d](ggseg3d.qmd) | `ggseg3d()`, cameras, surfaces, Shiny | [PDF](ggseg3d.pdf) |
| [Brain atlases and data structures](ggseg-atlases.qmd) | installing atlases, `ggseg_atlas` objects, atlas verbs | [PDF](ggseg-atlases.pdf) |

## Getting the packages

```r
options(repos = c(
  ggsegverse = "https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))

install.packages("ggsegverse")
```
